costBreakdown.scope: poolAccounted sums every launched seed account; poolUnreferencedReceipts adds receipts an interrupted search left that no account names; comparison sums the learning and frozen accounts of the four arms on the primary blocks, with a reconciled stage's retained receipts summed in its place.

costDefinitions.modelCalls: Charged executor attempts; no provider billing attestation.
costDefinitions.tokens: Recorded usage counted per admitted run, including content-identical receipts. One missing usage makes full totals null.
costDefinitions.workUnits: Runtime work accounting, including every failed or repeated admission.

limitations: The comparison is conditional on seed qualification, a pre-treatment event the launcher selected on; the six primary blocks are the lowest-index qualified searches, and that selection plausibly favors the optimizer.
Fresh draws from one shared synthetic template family do not represent separate domains or human-adjudicated support messages.
Validation selected seeds repeatedly and is not an untouched final test.
Arms ran at unequal recorded spend; a met rule is a descriptive win, not a matched-spend win.

A primary fixed or optimizer stage closed exhausted or short of its planned tasks; the primary rule has no verdict and no block replaced it. Missing: p-03/frozen-optimizer, p-08/frozen-optimizer, p-09/frozen-optimizer, p-10/frozen-optimizer, p-12/frozen-optimizer.
Transport-failed calls have uncertain external completion and missing usage; full token totals and provider charges remain unknown.

comparisonRule.aggregate: the sum of optimizer frozen scorerPassed strictly exceeds the sum of fixed frozen scorerPassed over the 48 PRIMARY frozen tasks
comparisonRule.coverage: all six PRIMARY blocks have fixed and optimizer learning outcome complete with 40 observed of 40 tasks and frozen outcome complete with 8 observed of 8; a reconciled fixed or optimizer stage on a PRIMARY block makes the primary insufficient with no replacement block
comparisonRule.matchedSpend: not tested; work per passed frozen task per arm and the optimizer to fixed work ratio are reported
comparisonRule.offlineAnalyses: per attempt of every launched search: exact train rows of 24, train summary exact, exact validation rows of 12, validation summary exact, missed validation record ids, labelsCorrect on train, validation, and development; per search: max exact validation rows, persistent misses, first generation at or above 11 and 10 exact rows, per-label summary declared; computed from stored receipts after collect, never a gate
comparisonRule.offlineReading: the threshold hypothesis predicts that unqualified searches split into single-persistent-miss searches reaching 11/12 and multi-miss searches that do not; the archived v7/v8 rate was 2 of 5 exhausted searches at 11/12
comparisonRule.successRule: descriptive-repeatability-rule-met if and only if coverage, wins, and aggregate all hold; otherwise not-met, or insufficient when coverage fails
comparisonRule.wins: PRIMARY blocks where optimizer frozen scorerPassed strictly exceeds fixed frozen scorerPassed; at least pool.winsRequired of pool.primarySize

method.developmentUse: A candidate that failed selection is executed once on a separate 12-record development batch; only its agreement score (rounded to hundredths) reaches later writer requests. No development records, labels, outputs, or summaries enter any request.
method.estimand: The seed procedure is v8 verbatim; the design changes. The estimand moves from planned denominators that count failed seed searches to a claim conditional on seed qualification, a pre-treatment event shared by all four arms: sixteen fresh blocks are seeded in protocol order at concurrency 3 until six closed searches qualify, cap sixteen, and the four arms run only on the six lowest-index qualified blocks. The v8 design needed thirteen qualifications before any comparison (P = 3.7e-4 at the recorded rate 0.545; 0.25 at 0.9), so its gate was infeasible rather than informative. The pool size 16, primary size 6, and win count 5 were derived from the v6-v8 seed-qualification rates and from no optimizer or fixed outcome, none of which exists. The selection plausibly favors the optimizer: a qualified block is one where the same writer already solved the convention from examples, and recorded fixed baselines on qualified seeds passed 1 to 4 of 8 frozen tasks, so a met rule is conditional and plausibly an upper bound.
method.lineRule: If fewer than six of sixteen seed searches qualify, or the primary rule is not met, the conditional-pool line ends; no larger pool, smaller primary set, lower win count, redrawn blocks, extra arms, or changed comparison rule is proposed on this axis.

poolRule.decision: written once to pool.json when every launched seed stage has result.json and hash-checked before any learning call
poolRule.headroom: the count of PRIMARY blocks whose fixed frozen scorerPassed is at most 6 is reported and never selects or excludes a block
poolRule.insufficient: if launches reached sixteen and fewer than six qualified: status insufficient, learn refuses, collect writes the negative result, no arm call
poolRule.interruptedSeed: a seed stage closed by reconcile counts as launched and not qualified
poolRule.nullTail: P(at least 5 of 6) = 7/64 = 0.109 under a no-tie null; v8's rule was 0.125
poolRule.primarySelection: the six lowest-index qualified blocks among launched blocks; every other launched block is qualified-not-compared, unqualified, or interrupted
poolRule.qualified: summary.qualified true, termination qualified, validation.passed equal to validation.total, duplicateRequests 0, manifest and catalog present
poolRule.stopLaunching: no new seed search launches once six closed searches have terminated qualified; every launched search runs to its own termination

method.runDiscipline: Each paid command (seed, learn, evaluate) runs as a detached background job that writes a log; monitors only tail the log; no session-bounded runner may own a paid stage. The v8 cal-d search was killed by a thirty-minute session monitor during generation seven, and by protocol it was not retried.
method.validationUse: Repeated selection of the first passing candidate; validation labels, outputs, and scores excluded from writer requests.
method.writerFeedback: Training examples, previous training output beside expected training output, the generation number, the predeclared round mode, and a bounded development score history of {generation, round, score} only, where score is the agreement value in [0,1] rounded to hundredths.
method.writerRequestIdentity: Digest of the executed writer program and its exact arguments; a duplicate request ends the search as a protocol failure.

offline.reading: the threshold hypothesis predicts that unqualified searches split into single-persistent-miss searches reaching 11/12 and multi-miss searches that do not; the archived v7/v8 rate was 2 of 5 exhausted searches at 11/12

primaryComparison.headroomRule: the count of PRIMARY blocks whose fixed frozen scorerPassed is at most 6 is reported and never selects or excludes a block
primaryComparison.interpretation: Descriptive comparisons of fresh draws from one synthetic template family, conditional on seed qualification; not statistical significance, distinct task domains, or matched spend.
primaryComparison.nullTail: P(at least 5 of 6) = 7/64 = 0.109 under a no-tie null; v8's rule was 0.125

workRatio.scope: learning and frozen work of each arm; the shared seed search is in poolCost

receiptFileTotals.scope: Per-receipt-file subtotals over every store, so a seed receipt copied into a learning store counts in both; token subtotals cover only effects that recorded usage.

recordedFailureLimit: A failed local receipt does not establish the exact abort cause, provider completion, or billing; each listed miss is a transport failure, not a scored miss.

verification.countScope: Receipt files per store; copied seed receipts are counted in every store that contains them.
verification.interpretation: Recorded execution replay is separate from task correctness and provider billing.
